title: SDF Forge
description: Sculpt raymarched 3D scenes from signed-distance primitives — blend blobs, tune materials, and export a scene or PNG.
concept: A WebGL raymarching scene builder: drop spheres, boxes, tori and capsules into a shared distance field, then drag their position/scale/rotation and smooth-blend nearby shapes into organic forms. Live soft shadows, ambient occlusion and specular highlights render every change instantly, with four starter presets (Atom, Blob Garden, Crystal, Snowman) to remix.
features: Add/select/delete sphere, box, torus and capsule primitives with per-object position, scale and rotation sliders
Per-object material controls — color, emissive glow, specular shine — blended smoothly where shapes merge
Global scene controls — smooth-min blend amount, sun azimuth/elevation, ambient occlusion strength, sky color
4 built-in preset scenes plus named save/load, JSON export/import, PNG screenshot export, and a shareable URL-hash link
Undo stack, localStorage autosave, orbit camera (drag) with wheel/pinch zoom

interaction.mouse: Drag canvas to orbit, scroll wheel to zoom, tap + to add a primitive, use sliders to transform/tune
interaction.click: Select object chips to edit; tap presets to load a starter scene
interaction.touch: Drag to orbit, two-finger pinch to zoom, tap controls in the bottom sheet
